instructions_to_main_agent: 1. INSTALL FONTS FIRST: Add the Google Fonts import to /app/frontend/src/index.css at the very top.
2. CONFIGURE TAILWIND: Update tailwind.config.js to extend the colors with the specific palette provided. Set 'borderRadius' to match the 'radius' section.
3. IMPLEMENT LAYOUTS: Use the specific 'grid_mode' strategies for Landing vs Dashboard.
4. USE SHADCN: Use existing shadcn components but OVERRIDE their default styles using the 'components' rules (e.g., bg-black/40 for cards).
5. DARK MODE ONLY: Force dark mode. Do not implement a light mode toggle. Set 'dark' class on the HTML or Body tag permanently.
6. DATA-TESTID: Ensure every interactive element has a 'data-testid' attribute.
7. NO GRADIENT TEXT: Avoid gradient text unless it's a very large hero title. Keep body text solid white/grey.
8. BORDERS: Use 'border-white/10' or 'border-white/5' for almost all borders. Avoid default heavy borders.
9. CHART COLORS: Configure Recharts to use the Primary (Cyan) and Secondary (Amber) colors.
universal_guidelines: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters.
